decision_target: Acquire exact Q4_K_M 4B embedding and reranker artifacts plus a pinned CUDA llama.cpp server for an 8 GB, controlled-candidate development shadow. Acquisition cannot qualify S1, prove natural candidate recall, replace source work, or promote a runtime.

owner_authority.authorized_request: Try a larger embedding model such as a 4B Qwen reranker on the current 8 GB GPU and compare it with the existing baseline.

embedding_node.purpose: score the unchanged 18-query DELL/MU/NVDA controlled candidate projection with both 0.6B baseline and quantized 4B challenger
embedding_node.input_scale: 18 queries and 86 candidate occurrences; longest observed query 631 characters and document 6505 characters
embedding_node.required_outputs: one normalized embedding score per query-candidate pair, per-case and overall pairwise/top1/MRR metrics, token counts, truncation receipts, latency and peak VRAM
embedding_node.schema_burden: exact eval digest, model/tool acquisition identities, fixed instruction, candidate identity and deterministic metric receipts
embedding_node.materiality_quality_risk: a controlled-pool gain does not prove external retrieval recall; truncation or identity drift could manufacture a ranking gain
embedding_node.comparable_run_evidence: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B must be rerun over the exact same 86 candidate occurrences
embedding_node.reasoning_profile: non-generative embedding; instruction-aware query and raw document
embedding_node.stop_and_truncation: sequential batch size one, preregistered token ceiling, fail on silent omission, CPU fallback, hidden input, or uncontrolled prompt change

reranker_node.purpose: score the same 86 query-document pairs through fixed yes/no relevance surfaces for 0.6B and quantized 4B
reranker_node.input_scale: 18 queries and 86 candidate occurrences with one-token yes/no scoring
reranker_node.required_outputs: yes/no log-probability difference, per-case and overall pairwise/top1/MRR metrics, prompt token counts, truncation receipts, latency and peak VRAM
reranker_node.schema_burden: exact tokenizer/prompt binding, model/tool identities, raw yes/no score receipts and deterministic metric compilation
reranker_node.materiality_quality_risk: community quant provenance, tokenization mismatch, or absent yes/no logits can make the challenger result non-comparable
reranker_node.comparable_run_evidence: Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B must be rerun over the exact same 86 candidate occurrences; historical 0.75 result is context only
reranker_node.reasoning_profile: bounded discriminative one-token yes/no scoring; free-form generation forbidden
reranker_node.stop_and_truncation: sequential batch size one, preregistered token ceiling, fail if yes/no probabilities are unavailable, prompt tokenization drifts, OOM occurs, or CPU fallback is attempted

known_boundary: This is a separate, owner-authorized 8 GB quantized development shadow. The official embedding quant is content-addressed; the selected reranker quant is community-produced and therefore cannot establish official full-precision behavior. Even a passing controlled-pool result will not repair inner/outer retrieval recall, close DELL public-information gaps, qualify S1, or authorize runtime promotion.
